dataList.name: L'Hémorragie interne
dataList.desc:
[AlwaysUseEGOPassive]
If this unit has 5 [BulletHole], does not consume E.G.O Resource when using "Hollow" E.G.O's Skills (both Awakening and Corrosion)

Turn Start: Gain 1 [BulletHole]

[WhenUseEGOPassive]
Turn Start: Gain 1 [BlackWingHole]

Heal 5 SP every time this unit consumes or loses 3 cumulative [Bullet], and gain 1 [ResultEnhancement] next turn (including Unique [Bullet]; counts up to 9 [Bullet] per turn)
dataList.flavor:
The gaze of another nails into me, driving a hollow from which multitudes spill forth.
The discharge is then forged into a bullet that punches a hollow into you.
